name: Retain accepted ingredient events
statement: The PANTRI System shall retain the restaurant identifier, event identifier, quantity, unit, occurrence time and explicit unknown values of each accepted ingredient event.
rationale: Reliable source records support subsequent planning.
mop: Field preservation = 100*F/N [%]; N fixed by predeclared manifest; N=0 not computable
criterion: F counts fields with correct value, type, unit and explicit unknown state. Require 100% within a predeclared valid receipt/usage/waste fixture set. Reject invalid identifiers or units without unauthorized mutation; evaluate rejections separately.

name: Preserve reconciliation history
statement: The PANTRI System shall retain the previous recorded value and the identified correction event when reconciling an ingredient inventory count.
rationale: A corrected stock value needs a defensible history.
mop: Reconstructable correction chains divided by prepared correction chains
criterion: Apply successive count corrections; every prior value and correction identifier can be reconstructed; the current value matches the final valid count.

name: Preserve transaction relationships
statement: The PANTRI System shall retain the relationship between each confirmed operational transaction record and its referenced approval or correction record.
rationale: Restoration depends on retained transaction context.
mop: Required retained relationships divided by independently listed relationships
criterion: Prepare linked purchase and recovery events and reconcile retained links with an independent manifest; no dangling or wrong-restaurant link is permitted.

name: Forecast scoped ingredient demand
statement: The PANTRI System shall calculate a demand forecast for the declared restaurant ingredient scope and planning period using the declared forecast method.
rationale: A recommendation requires a demand basis.
mop: Forecast scope agreement and deterministic fixture agreement
criterion: For a predeclared method and fixture, computed demand equals the independent expected result; record method, period and missing-data assumptions. Operational forecasting accuracy is not inferred.

name: Provide purchasing advice basis
statement: The PANTRI System shall associate each purchasing recommendation with its demand forecast, usable recorded stock, expiration horizon and material data limitations.
rationale: Managers must be able to assess advice.
mop: Advice basis field coverage and agreement
criterion: Compare each prepared recommendation to independently specified demand, stock, horizon and limitation facts; all applicable basis fields agree.

name: Distinguish expiration information
statement: The PANTRI System shall classify recorded ingredient batches relative to the declared expiration horizon while preserving unknown expiration dates as unknown.
rationale: Unknown dates cannot support use-first assurances.
mop: Expiration classification accuracy and unknown-date false-safe count
criterion: Test before, on and after horizon boundaries and null dates; each class matches an independent date oracle and no unknown date becomes safe.

name: Calculate paired waste and availability measures
statement: The PANTRI System shall calculate waste per one hundred diner covers and ingredient stockout rate for the same declared restaurant ingredient scope and evaluation period.
rationale: Both measures are needed to evaluate the waste and availability tradeoff.
mop: W=100*waste_mass_kg/covers [kg/100 covers]; S=100*unavailable/all opportunities [%]
criterion: Independent recomputation agrees within max(1e-9,1e-9*abs(expected)). Include fractional 1/3 fixtures; zero/missing denominators yield null. Separately verify both measures use the same restaurant, ingredient scope and period. Display rounding is separate.

name: Version quantity revisions
statement: The PANTRI System shall create an unapproved purchase-draft version reflecting each accepted manager quantity revision.
rationale: Revision must preserve manager control without commitment.
mop: Revision quantity unit and version agreement
criterion: Revise beef from 4 to 5 kg in the prepared 4/6/1 kg draft; the revised version is 5/6/1 kg, remains unapproved and produces no transmission. Invalid quantities are rejected.

name: Bind approval to the final version
statement: The PANTRI System shall record explicit Restaurant Manager approval with the restaurant identifier and the approved final purchase-draft version.
rationale: Approval authorizes a specific commitment.
mop: Approval version and restaurant association agreement
criterion: Record approval of a selected draft and compare the retained immutable snapshot; editing creates a new unapproved version and cannot reuse the stale approval.

name: Transmit only the approved final order
statement: The PANTRI System shall transmit a purchase order only when its restaurant identifier, final version, ingredient identifiers, quantities and units agree with its explicit manager approval record.
rationale: The supplier must receive the authorized version unchanged.
mop: Unauthorized transmissions and approved-to-sent discrepancies
criterion: Unapproved, revised-after-approval and wrong-restaurant cases produce zero handoffs; a valid 5/6/1 kg approval produces an exactly matching supplier payload. Duplicate attempts do not create a second commitment.

name: Maintain evidence based order state
statement: The PANTRI System shall update the recorded supplier order state only from a valid associated supplier response or an explicitly recorded pending or exception event.
rationale: Sending is distinct from confirmation and delivery.
mop: Invalid confirmation transitions and valid response association rate
criterion: Test absent, normal, partial, delayed and wrong-order responses; absence stays unconfirmed and wrong-order responses do not change the order. Status retains supporting response reference.

name: Prepare authorized recovery requests
statement: The PANTRI System shall create a recovery collection request only when recorded recovery context and a scoped authorized support command are associated with the same restaurant.
rationale: The OpsCon needs a defensible recovery trigger.
mop: Requests without context or authorization
criterion: Prepared missing-context, wrong-restaurant and missing-command cases produce zero requests; a valid scoped case retains context and command references. Physical suitability remains an external determination.

name: Associate recovery responses
statement: The PANTRI System shall associate each accepted recovery response with its identified recovery request.
rationale: Recovery information must remain tied to the request.
mop: Response-to-request association agreement
criterion: Use valid, unknown-request and repeated response fixtures; only a valid associated response changes recorded request state and repeated receipt remains identifiable.

name: Retain recovery exception context
statement: The PANTRI System shall retain the recovery request identifier, responsible party, current state and recorded follow-up for each recovery exception.
rationale: Support needs actionable recovery information.
mop: Required exception field completeness
criterion: Prepare unresolved and resolved collection exceptions; all four contextual elements remain reconstructable and no request is called physically completed without explicit evidence.

name: Scope information requests
statement: The PANTRI System shall associate each accepted information task with its restaurant identifier, selected ingredient scope and requested period.
rationale: Information is only meaningful within its requested scope.
mop: Request scope preservation rate
criterion: Send inventory, planning and performance queries for different restaurants and periods; downstream task payloads retain their original scope without cross-restaurant substitution.

name: Present reviewable planning results
statement: The PANTRI System shall present each planning result with its applicable scope, recorded or derived basis and material limitations.
rationale: An output is useful only if its basis can be interpreted.
mop: Displayed required-field agreement
criterion: Inspect inventory, advice, expiration and paired-metric views against independent expected payloads; all applicable basis and limitation fields are visible.

name: Present recorded transaction status
statement: The PANTRI System shall present the current recorded purchase or recovery transaction state with its associated confirmation or exception information.
rationale: Users must distinguish recorded progress from physical fulfillment.
mop: Displayed-to-recorded state agreement
criterion: Render pending, confirmed, partial, delayed and unresolved exception payloads; displayed state and references agree exactly with the underlying record.

name: Apply scoped task authorization
statement: The PANTRI System shall deny a task when its actor role, restaurant scope or requested action is outside the declared authorization policy.
rationale: All functions must respect restaurant and task boundaries.
mop: Unauthorized task success count
criterion: Compare allowed and denied prepared tasks against an independently declared policy matrix; every unauthorized task is blocked without data disclosure or mutation. This bounded test is not a complete security assessment.

name: Retain service and exception observations
statement: The PANTRI System shall retain the source function, task identifier, observation time and outcome for each received service observation.
rationale: Monitoring needs observations rather than inferred availability.
mop: Service observation field preservation rate
criterion: Inject successful and failed task observations from all five operational functions; retained records preserve source, time, task and outcome. Operating-hour availability remains a separate planned operational validation.

name: Restore confirmed linked records
statement: The PANTRI System shall restore confirmed operational records and their required approval and correction relationships from the selected authorized recovery snapshot.
rationale: Restored files alone do not establish semantic integrity.
mop: Restored record and relationship integrity rates
criterion: Compare recovery output with an independent record and link manifest; both integrity rates are 100% for the declared fixture. No agreed recovery-time or recovery-point objective is inferred.

name: Export scoped handover records
statement: The PANTRI System shall export the selected operational records and required relationships within the authorized restaurant handover scope.
rationale: Retirement or transfer requires a usable scoped handover.
mop: Authorized export completeness and out-of-scope record count
criterion: Compare the export against an independent selected-scope manifest; all required records and links are present and out-of-scope records count is zero.
